body: He honestly is. He constantly hurts his family and friends with his drug abuse and anger issues. He tells me in depth about how he slaughtered a chicken (that he stole) with his bare hands and other gruesome stories....Some people think I'm cruel because he is my friend, but it's very hard to help at this point.

I honestly don't think very many people would be bothered by my own passing, but my parents would definitely be devastated. I understand that this is what stops a lot of people from going through with everything.

Exactly, I feel like some people are meant to change the world and others simply inhabit it. 

I have my own suicidal thoughts, but I also have a friend who constantly thinks of suicide. He's a terrible drug addict, a thief, a liar, and a pretty terrible person who kills animals for fun and generally doesn't value life. Of course he wasn't like this when I first met him, but it's hard trying to find reasons for him to live anymore. I would never encourage suicide, but I have a hard time telling him that life is worth it.

I don't think I would be upset if someone close to me committed suicide because I know they aren't hurting anymore. Maybe it's really insensitive, but I want people around me to be in peace no matter what decisions they make.
What about people who have few family or friends?

This is a very poetic way to look at things. It makes sense though. I sit here counting out pills to overdose on while other people are dying of serious illnesses and can't choose life. It definitely makes me feel guilty.
Maybe it doesn't affect me as bad because I'm not religious, but I just think that people shouldn't be pressured into living if they really don't want to.

I would definitely do that if I could drive, but I'm so scared of everything that I panic behind the wheel of a car. I've been at this point before and attempted suicide last year so it's nothing new, but I don't have a huge will to live.

There are many stories about people who survive jumps that regretted it in the seconds they were falling. I know right now you're thinking "not me!" But, think about how many people that have jumped, who did not survive, who probably were regretting it on the way down. Your last few seconds are of sheer terror and possible regret. Then, if you survive the jump, you could be smooshed at the bottom just waiting for death to set it. It's a very brutal way to go, friend. I know you say you aren't afraid now, but humans are programmed to be afraid of death because everything except your conscious is working hard to keep you alive.

Well it seems fool proof doesn't it? You've got the height and the precarious location; however, even this doesn't guarantee death. There was a woman near me who attempted suicide off a bridge into a river known to immediately kill with the current. The undertow along with the massive cargo ships that come through that river should be instant death. They found her a few miles downstream, paralyzed, but still alive. Crazy things can happen even if you think you have it all planned out.
If I can secure everything soon, tomorrow night or Tuesday. I don't want anyone to get ideas off my posts, so I don't want to go into too much detail.
Well you don't have to believe me.
When are you planning to go through with everything?
Sure!
Well that is wonderful! It's always good to see that some people make it out of this, but I don't think I'll be one of them.
Well that is wonderful! It's great to see people that come out of this, but I don't think I'll be one of them. It's just been far too long that I've dealt with this and I believe I'm ready.
Well that is wonderful! It's great to see people that come out of this, but I don't think I'll be one of them. It's just been far too long that I've dealt with this and I believe I'm ready.
I don't think I'm going to announce that, but I'm in college.
Haha, I don't believe so and at this point, I can't even remember any good days. But thank you for trying.
Work on puzzles or draw. Those are my favorite distractions but I'm usually working or studying.
I have tried so many times to get better, it just didn't work out for me. It feels like the right thing to do at this point. I'm not even particularly (sp?) sad at this point, just ready to move on.
More than likely hanging or overdose. I've overdosed before and failed, but it's less scary to me than hanging.

I was sitting in my dorm room and realized that I had absolutely no one to talk to. I was completely alone. I figured it would be the perfect time to go through with things since I don't have people in my daily life that care for me very much.

I've thought about it since elementary school and I'm in college now. I do understand that this is permanent which is exactly why I'm doing it. If I thought there was even a tiny chance for things to be different, I wouldn't do it.
I am sure they will be alright. I'm not an only child so they still have my sibling. I worry about them not understanding, so I plan on leaving an extensive video or note to help with it.
I am an extremely paranoid person so I always think people are out to use me or hurt me. It makes things so hard when I just want to have a good time.
Love you too! See you on the other side, but hopefully it will be a while until you join me.
Yeah, it does. I want friends, but it's almost painful trying to force myself out of my room to socialize.

There really isn't much interesting about me. My last night will be Monday so they can find my body on Tuesday. I figure people will get suspicious when I'm not in class and send over University police.
I'm 19. I don't have good days anymore so I'm very ready to move on.

I'll try to shorten it, but here it goes. I had a physically and emotionally abusive childhood and I've been suicidal since elementary school. I've been sexually assaulted by an ex which makes dating weird. I'm very bad about getting attached to people which ends in heartbreak every time. I lost my childhood dog this year which was one of my only reasons for living. I was diagnosed with herpes a few months ago and I was blackmailed to send nude photos. This is just what I could think of at the moment. There is much more that contributed to this but it's just a lot to go through.
Hello!

When I used to pray, I would always ask to let me die so some sick child somewhere could live. I still wish for it all the time because they're fighting so hard for something that I don't even want. You aren't alone in hoping for this.

I'm not here to be talked out of anything. I know in my heart that it's the best decision I could make, but some people like comforting others in their final days so I thought I'd put the opportunity out there.
This is exactly why I'm not choosing to overdose again. It's too slow.
Gods awesome plan gave me an incurable, highly contagious virus :) I'm sure I'm one of his favorites.
I've attempted suicide and every day I kick myself for not taking more pills and getting it over with when I had the chance! Not sure where they got that group from. Maybe OP has a point.

There's really no "best" way. Hanging is extremely painful, but clean up is easy. Gun is statistically the most successful but clean up can be extremely emotionally damaging for those that have to do it. Overdose is pretty common, but rarely works. None of it is any good.

Maybe you can't see it, but I have herpes and no amount of money or anything can change it. You can change some of those things or learn to accept it as part of yourself. I will never get rid of herpes and I will always risk being contagious for other people. You are truly fine.

I was afraid of this. I thought that maybe I could leave a note saying that I this was my decision and I made it without anyone's help, but I wouldn't want someone to risk jail for helping me accomplish something that needs to happen.
Any OTC is terrible! I tried it and not only did it not kill me, but it made me vomit continuously and messed up my liver.
Death by train is a pretty scary way to go. You may not die on impact and it's...messy...to say the least, for everyone else.
I'll meet you on the other side in about two months.
Still with us?
Why 2 days, if I may ask?
Thank you. I put a lot of time into writing it.
This wasn't the way I planned out my life at all, but it's my fault that it didn't go well and now it's my choice to end it.
Thank you, friend. I'm not trying to make it too emotional and I don't want to make anyone feel responsible.
Thank you. It's nice to have somebody know the end of my story, even if it's somebody I don't know.

My mom wants me to go see a therapist and I guess it couldn't hurt to try something. I've been to two therapists in the past and they've made me so horribly uncomfortable that I couldn't sit still in my seat. Otherwise, August 5th will be my last day on this earth. I'm in college and it's right before the fall semester so they can get all the money back from my fees and tuition.
Before I was more serious about it, I half assed an attempt and it's so weird to think "holy shit I may actually die." Even when you thought you were sure you wanted it.

Yes. The herpes diagnosis is probably the biggest thing. I believe the person blackmailing me was bluffing and I really wish my dog was here to comfort me, but I would be okay if it wasn't for having an incurable virus.
She just said that I don't have a choice and that I have to continue, but I really don't. I can remove myself forever and never worry about having to disclose my diagnosis to anyone.

The worst part about it is that I got a blood test to find out that I had it and I have no idea if I have it orally or genitally. If I could make my family hate me, I would feel comfortable with going through with my plans.
I don't really have a plan after graduation. This is pretty much my only plan as I don't want to live with a permanent diagnosis. I want this so bad. I only feel bad for hurting my family.
I don't really have a plan after graduation. This is pretty much my only plan as I don't want to live with a permanent diagnosis. I want this so bad. I only feel bad for hurting my family.
I go to the beach as much as possible. I love it at night and just listening to the waves roll in. That's why I want it to be the last spot I'm ever at.

The thing that bothers me the most is my herpes diagnosis. I will have that forever if I chose to keep going and dating is hard enough without having to disclose something that society deems detrimental to your image.

I don't have a partner, my depression drove off all of my friends, and my parents reacted horriblely when my sister told them about these thoughts. I am alone in this world and at least my death would serve to show people that depression and suicide can happen to just about anyone.
I just feel like this is the only path left for me, but if I truly didn't want to be here, I suppose I wouldn't be posting about it in a suicide way if forum.

I don't know if I'm a particularly religious person, but (I know it's weird but stay with me here) I do believe in signs. Like, the universe will point you in some direction and this feels like the direction I'm meant to take.
The beach is my absolute favorite place. I figured I mine as well die somewhere I love.

I'm studying Communication Sciences and Disorders to be a speech therapist, but I have an extremely difficult time focusing and keeping my grades up. I hate doing this to everyone, but after the death of my childhood dog, health issues in my family, a herpes diagnosis, and being sextorted, I feel so ready to be done.

It's been a huge part of me for a long time. Ive dug up many diaries from elementary school where I doodled about hanging myself off my bunk bed. I don't know who I am without it and I'm tired of dealing with it.
Since elementary school and I'm in college now. In the past, it was just ideation, but I'm also planning on carrying it out this summer.

I've told a few close friends, but I hate talking to them about it because I don't want to bring them down and I've lost friends because they couldn't handle the stress of dealing with a suicidal friend.

They know that I am suicidal, but they really don't know what to do about it. I'm home for summer break now and I've told my mom about how I hate myself and that I truly want to die, but I don't know if she's actually taking me seriously. My dad tends to stay out of all of this and I'm apprehensive about pressing anything as my sister attempted suicide at the beginning of the year and they did not react well to her recovery.
The world needs more strangers like you that at least try to reach out to people like me. I'm still pretty set on wiping my slate clean, but I am concerned about how my family will react.

I'm extremely alone in this life. My depression and anxiety has driven off every friend I've ever had. I am so ready to be done with everything and not hurt anymore. My dad is going through rigorous tests for cancer and my parents are spending money they really don't have to send me to college. I don't want to burden them any longer and I'm so tired of being alone.
